fusions.name: Smothering Wrap
fusions.desc: Flings a wrap that deals 11 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Flung Netting
fusions.desc: Flings a net through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 25% chance to leave each enemy caught [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Covered Over
fusions.desc: Veils you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Padded Cell
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
